mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for 2 months, it signals economic distress that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline while industrial production (INDPRO) rises, it indicates consumer demand contraction amid supply expansion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% in 1 month and INDPRO rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls > 0.5% and INDPRO rises > 0.3% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized), a federal funds rate decline triggers positive equity returns as central banks ease policy to counter inflation, over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500.0 thousand units, it signals weakening consumer demand for housing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises while GDP growth (GDPC1) falls, it indicates supply-side disruption that reduces corporate profitability and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 1 month and GDPC1 falls > 0.1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO rises > 0.5% and GDPC1 falls > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% annualized), a rising federal funds rate signals monetary tightening that reduces liquidity and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 1.5% and FEDFUNDS rises.
